title: ICF
description: The &3ICF&r reactor is a very expensive and powerful reactor, which can produce a substantial amount of energy. Apart from the multiblock itself, &3ICF Lasers&r must be constructed for the reactor to work. &bStellar Flux&r will be produced during its operation which is needed to craft &6Gerald&r. Consider making use of &bLiquid Lead&r as it is a very efficient coolant for the ICF.
&2A Plasma Forge with a plasma input energy of 1MTU/t is required.&r
It is recommended that the wiki is checked out as it has built-in calculators for the laser power consumption and the amount of hot coolant it produces.
